title: Jetexir V1.0 has landed. 17 addons to supercharge your WooCommerce store
description: The first stable release of Jetexir is here. Explore the full list of addons that ship with V1.0, from sale badges and fly cart to custom order statuses and sequential order numbers.
summary: We are thrilled to announce the first stable release of Jetexir V1.0, a free, open source enhancement suite for WooCommerce.
